chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 275: The Jingu Plain War
chapter_meta_description: Han Li survives a year of Foundation Establishment-level warfare, acquires a Dragon Sing Grass, secures two ancient formulas, and waits for his chance to find Qi Yunxiao.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 275 — The War of Attrition
og_description: Han Li has survived a year of grinding, asymmetric warfare on the Jingu Plain. The Foundation Establishment die in droves; Core Formation cultivators remain invincible. But Han Li is accumulating, trading, and waiting for his real move.
twitter_description: A year of war, zero Core Formation deaths, hundreds of Foundation Establishment kills. Han Li buys a Dragon Sing Grass, gets two formulas for cheap, and plays the long game.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare natural concentration of spiritual qi formed over millennia; meditating near one accelerates cultivation by 20-30%.
The main battlefield between the Seven Sects of Yue and the Six Demonic Clans; a site of daily Foundation Establishment-level skirmishes and nightly Core Formation duels.
The second major cultivation realm, granting a lifespan of ~200 years and the ability to use mid-grade magic tools; the primary casualty bracket in the Jingu Plain war.
The third major cultivation realm, granting a ~500-year lifespan and vastly superior combat speed; effectively invincible in the war's current balance.
A prehistoric formation capable of crossing millions of li; its repair knowledge is lost in modern times.
A rare, valuable spiritual herb used in alchemy; requires 500 spirit stones on the Jingu Plain black market.
A cultivation pill for accelerating mana accumulation; Han Li has now acquired all its ingredients.
A basic formation used by cultivators to imprint their essence blood on beast eggs, establishing ownership and control.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why has no Core Formation cultivator died in a year?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Their flight speed and defensive capabilities make a successful kill nearly impossible; a Core Formation cultivator can retreat faster than any peer can pursue, and killing one would require a decisive power advantage or a perfect trap.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li keep buying ancient formulas?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A single viable pill formula is a permanent multiplying asset; unlike a single pill, a formula lets Han Li produce as many pills as his ingredients allow, making it the highest-return investment in the Mortal Stream economy.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are Qi Condensation cultivators saved as reserves?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are too weak to survive the daily skirmishes, so both sides preserve them as a strategic reserve for the final decisive battle, making them the lowest priority casualties in the war.
